sentences.text: Mucopolysaccharidosis type 3B and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease axonal type 2V are both recorded as caused by the gene NAGLU [e_244c274fe2aa] [e_2734b3a5f5c8].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from OMIM and Orphanet [e_244c274fe2aa] [e_2734b3a5f5c8].
Constellate computed that the two conditions share this causal gene, at confidence 0.95 [e_27996e898ba6].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_27996e898ba6].

For mucopolysaccharidosis type 3B, two observed features are recorded, reduced activity of the NAGLU enzyme in tissue in 7 of 7 cases and dysostosis multiplex, a bone shape abnormality, in 16 of 16 cases [e_e4b2e587ca9e] [e_8c34ce98654b].
These edges do not show how one gene leads to two different conditions, and they list no symptoms for the nerve condition [e_27996e898ba6] [e_2734b3a5f5c8].
They also show no studies, no treatments and no patient groups [e_244c274fe2aa].
